description: The 16-line held-out carpenter call from spikes/5-transcript-holdout.txt, never used for tuning: scored only after the wrap-up rules were committed (a382fdb). Made-up timings (1.5 s plus a second per 15 characters, 1 s apart); the call ends 1 s after the last line. Meena hires Vijay for a wardrobe. The deal is taken as started on WhatsApp, so Vijay's name is not known at the start.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Vijay bhaiya, bedroom mein ek wardrobe banwana hai, floor se ceiling tak.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ban jayega didi. Kitna chauda chahiye?

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Saat foot chauda, teen darwaze, andar do drawer.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Theek hai, saat foot ka teen door wardrobe, do drawer ke saath, plywood aur laminate mera. Yeh pakka.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Gawah, yeh sab record ho raha hai na?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan didi, ho raha hoga. Toh kaam ka 60 hazaar lagega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Chalo theek hai, 55 hazaar. Kaam kab tak poora hoga?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Jaldi kar denge didi, aap chinta mat karo. Advance 20 hazaar bhej dena aaj.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: 20 theek hai, aaj shaam ko bhej dungi. Baaki kaam poora hone ke baad.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan didi, baaki 35 kaam khatam hone par de dena.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai. Toh 20 advance aur total 50, sahi hai na?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji didi. Kal subah aata hoon naap lene.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai bhaiya, kal milte hain. Thank you.
